theme_central: "The Overwhelming Event": humbled faces in a blazing fire contrasted with joyful faces in an elevated garden — then a return to signs visible to all: camels, sky, mountains, earth.

branches.title: Humbled faces
branches.resume: Humbled faces, toiling in vain effort, burning in a blazing Fire, food that does not satisfy hunger.

children.t: Humbled faces, punishment and thorny food

branches.title: Joyful faces
branches.resume: Joyful faces in an elevated garden, springs, couches, cups and cushions.

children.t: Joyful faces in Paradise, elevated garden and comfort

branches.title: Signs of creation
branches.resume: The camels, the sky, the mountains, the earth — an invitation to observe how they were created.

children.t: Camels, sky, mountains, earth as signs to observe

branches.title: The Prophet's mission, closing
branches.resume: The Prophet is only a reminder-bearer without coercive authority; the final return is to Allah.

children.t: The Prophet's mission to remind, final return to Allah
